summary: The property is stabilized, so next year's rent growth at renewal is the biggest lever; the contract re-bid and the lighting are smaller and already priced from this property's own accounts.

moves.title: Raise rents about 3% at renewal next year
moves.impact: about $11,800 a year on the in-place NOI
moves.besideStory: Rent annualized from the last three months (occupancy gained in the spring)
moves.rationale: Vacancy loss runs 3.6% of gross potential rent, so the property is stabilized. A 3% increase at renewal on the underwritten rent adds about $11,800 a year in place once every lease has renewed; Safe already counts the spring's rent, so the push is measured from there, less the management fee that rises with revenue.
